summary: Misamis Occidental 2nd District representative with 47 principal-authored bills. Authored zero-interest salary loans for employees, a rationalization of special tax privileges for airlines, higher campaign expense limits for candidates and parties, a Justice Department staffing bill and a higher PNP retirement age. Co-authored the national minimum wage.
caveat: Direction of the airline-tax rationalization was not reviewed. Campaign expense limits are a single institutions issue and unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored zero-interest salary loans for employees (-1) and rationalization of airline tax privileges (-1, direction assumed); co-authored the national minimum wage (-2).
